audit.scope: Byte-for-byte SHA-256 comparison of all archive CSV/JSON files present at the same repository paths.

notes: The result archive contains rendered microscopy/QC PNGs, not raw TIFF/NPY/NPZ microscopy or instance arrays. Third-party originals remain at their source repositories.
Archived HAEC test-probe tables use fields 0005, 0010, 0015, and 0020 during decoder debugging; field-disjoint training splits do not establish an untouched confirmatory test set.
Archived development PNGs predate the v6_pool frontier results. Their checkpoint labels must be retained when reusing model overlays.
The archive includes historical result documents; extracting over current docs/ would restore pre-consolidation documentation.

Eight checkpoint binaries, seven individual model cards, and one models/README.md index are archived. The v5_vertex checkpoint has no separate archived card; its training config/log and v6_pool card document its lineage.

audit.difference_explanation: Seven individual model cards differ only by the later fetch_zenodo download instruction paragraph; models/README.md differs only by DOI/version wiring. Shared training configuration/log contents are identical.
